case_brief.subject: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
case_brief.administering_body: Union Ministry of Labour and Employment
case_brief.what_it_is: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is a central sector employment-linked incentive scheme designed to encourage job creation in the formal sector. It provides financial incentives to both first-time employees and employers to support social security coverage and new job generation.
case_brief.entitlement: First-time employees receive a one-time incentive equivalent to an average one-month wage (Basic+DA) of up to Rs 15,000, paid in two installments. Employers receive incentives based on salary slabs for new employees (Rs 1,000 for Rs 10,000 salary; Rs 2,000 for Rs 10,000-20,000 salary; Rs 3,000 for up to Rs 30,000 salary) or up to Rs 3,000 per month for additional employees for a sustained period.
conditions: The employee must be a first-time employee.
The employee must have gross wages up to Rs 1 lakh.
The employee must register on the PMVBRY portal or upload their UAN number on the UMANG App.
For employer incentives, the establishment must hire at least two additional employees if they have fewer than 50 existing employees.
For employer incentives, the establishment must hire at least five additional employees if they have 50 or more existing employees.
The establishment must file the electronic challan-cum-Return (ECR).
The establishment must open UANs for all existing and new employees using the facility on the UMANG App.

case_brief.administering_body: Union Ministry of Labour and Employment
case_brief.what_it_is: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is a central sector employment-linked incentive scheme designed to encourage job creation in the formal sector. It provides financial incentives to both first-time employees and employers to support social security coverage and new job generation.
case_brief.entitlement: First-time employees receive a one-time incentive equivalent to an average one-month wage (Basic+DA) of up to Rs 15,000, paid in two installments. Employers receive incentives based on salary slabs for new employees (Rs 1,000 for Rs 10,000 salary; Rs 2,000 for Rs 10,000-20,000 salary; Rs 3,000 for up to Rs 30,000 salary) or up to Rs 3,000 per month for additional employees for a sustained period.

eligibility.message: From what you've told us, you may not meet: The employee must have gross wages up to Rs 1 lakh. The letter will ask the office to check its records and explain, not claim the benefit as due.

unresolved_critic_notes: Amount 'Rs 1,10,000' does not match any amount the complainant gave - use their figure or a [PLACEHOLDER].

Reviewer: The letter acknowledges that the complainant's gross wage is Rs 1,10,000, which exceeds the scheme's eligibility condition of 'up to Rs 1 lakh', making the grievance logically inconsistent as the complainant is ineligible based on their own stated facts.
